images.caption: Figure 2:Data construction pipeline. (A) Independent tasks are developed from curated text seeds, reference images, and video clips. (B) Paired T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks are derived from shared complete source videos. (C) Both task sets undergo prompt construction, QA checklist development, and annotation of subjects, temporal events, motion types, and three complexity dimensions, yielding 2,104 tasks.

Figure 4:Task complexity and prompt length. C, D, and S denote construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity. (a) Record counts by category and complexity level (1–3), with multi-label records counted in each assigned category. (b) Prompt token distributions across T2V, I2V, and V2V, as in Tab.1.
